export BAPR_PYTHON=/home/zhengliang01/scheduleurm_work/conda_envs/csbapr-gpu-py310/bin/python; export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/cm/local/apps/cuda-driver/libs/535.261.03/lib64; export PATH=/home/zhengliang01/scheduleurm_work/conda_envs/csbapr-gpu-py310/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin; set -u
mkdir -p /tmp/scheduleurm_durable_control
if mkdir /tmp/scheduleurm_durable_control/cfcmt-v86-interference-node003-v1 2>/dev/null; then
  printf '%s'  | base64 -d > /tmp/scheduleurm_durable_control/cfcmt-v86-interference-node003-v1/command.sh
  printf '%s'  | base64 -d > /tmp/scheduleurm_durable_control/cfcmt-v86-interference-node003-v1/supervisor.sh
  chmod 700 /tmp/scheduleurm_durable_control/cfcmt-v86-interference-node003-v1/command.sh /tmp/scheduleurm_durable_control/cfcmt-v86-interference-node003-v1/supervisor.sh
  setsid bash /tmp/scheduleurm_durable_control/cfcmt-v86-interference-node003-v1/supervisor.sh </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1 &
  supervisor_pid=$!
  printf '%s\n' "$supervisor_pid" > /tmp/scheduleurm_durable_control/cfcmt-v86-interference-node003-v1/pid.tmp
  mv /tmp/scheduleurm_durable_control/cfcmt-v86-interference-node003-v1/pid.tmp /tmp/scheduleurm_durable_control/cfcmt-v86-interference-node003-v1/pid
  touch /tmp/scheduleurm_durable_control/cfcmt-v86-interference-node003-v1/launched
  printf '__DURABLE_STATE__ LAUNCHED\n'
else
  if [ -f /tmp/scheduleurm_durable_control/cfcmt-v86-interference-node003-v1/launched ] || [ -f /tmp/scheduleurm_durable_control/cfcmt-v86-interference-node003-v1/done ]; then
    printf '__DURABLE_STATE__ RESUMED\n'
  else
    printf '__DURABLE_STATE__ PENDING\n'
  fi
fi
if [ -f /tmp/scheduleurm_durable_control/cfcmt-v86-interference-node003-v1/pid ]; then printf '__DURABLE_PID__ '; cat /tmp/scheduleurm_durable_control/cfcmt-v86-interference-node003-v1/pid; fi
